trigger: User requested MiniLM L6 and L12 tested separately as coarse retrieval and verification, with model size and runtime cost included in the decision.

roles.coarse: Official sentence-transformer mask mean pooling and L2 normalization; exact pinned tokenizer, dimensionality and sequence length; no reranker CLS substitution.
roles.verification: Official query-document tokenizer pair and classification logit; do not reuse the Qwen .95 probability threshold or assume a score is answerability.
roles.language: The all-MiniLM and English MS MARCO variants are English-labelled checkpoints. Chinese and both cross-language directions remain mandatory empirical groups, not assumed supported. Existing multilingual L12 variants are separate reference models.

data.holdouts: No check query, consumed acceptance result or acceptance-v6 fixture is used for fitting or selection.
data.source: Original case-preserving same-field text,96 UTF16-character windows with16 overlap, current90a source lexical capture and complete structured-ID eligibility.

collection.coarse: Collect all60 document vectors and248 query vectors per model; keep token counts, complete/truncated status, EOS/special-token contract, model/runtime/tokenizer fingerprints.
collection.pairUnion: Union of raw top5 per query across all three coarse models after complete structured-ID eligibility, plus every actual current-source weak lexical field. Deduplicate only exact query/source/field/revision/window identities.
collection.overLimit: Do not truncate to make a result; record unknown and incomplete coverage.
collection.quantization: Use pinned official ONNX AVX2 quantized artifacts where available; FP32 versus Q8 token/logit/vector samples recorded as lossy comparison, not assumed equivalent.
collection.execution: One model computation workload at a time. Capture real process identity and observed exit; run resource/latency qualification separately without concurrent model workloads.

developmentMatrix.core: L6 coarse/L6 verifier, L6/L12, L12/L6, L12/L12; multilingual references extend the same matrix rather than replacing failed English variants.
developmentMatrix.note: The .34 point is the existing small-model setting, an explicit comparison rather than an assumed calibration shared by all checkpoints. Coarse cutoffs never remove independently required weak-lexical verification work.
developmentMatrix.strongEvidence: Preserve authenticated same-field exact phrase, complete effective terms and complete IDs; choose K before strong exemption and never refill K.
developmentMatrix.ranking: Preserve the coarse order and actual lexical/semantic RRF after admission, before final limit; all unknown and partial results stay in prescribed denominators.
developmentMatrix.selection: Require both train/calibration Chinese R@5>=.90, both cross-language R@5>=.85, MRR>=.75, pure unrelated OOD FPR<=.05, exact-ID preservation and complete prescribed pair coverage. Compare byte cost, actual warm new-query/repeated-query latency, paired memory and lifecycle only among qualified candidates; do not assume the largest model wins.

reporting.quality: Separate Chinese, English, both cross-language directions, pure unrelated OOD, identifier mismatch and related missing-fact diagnostics.
reporting.resources: Model/tokenizer/dependency bytes and final ZIP measured separately; cold/index/prewarm separate from warm new queries/repeats; actual process RSS/private samples and total paired memory reported without adding independent peaks.
reporting.boundaries: Development matrix and model microbenchmarks cannot close3.1 gates. Fresh independent quality, current producer/all planned consumers, privacy/lifecycle,1000-fragment p95 and new packages remain required. Default, production model manifest, release version and automatic:null are unchanged.
